title: Attract the Right Audience
full: Attract the Right Audience: Nail Your Go-to-Market Strategy First
headline: Know the audience before a single piece of content gets made.
summary: Nail the go-to-market strategy first. Define the audience, clarify the value and choose the right messages before a dollar goes to production.
block: Businesses create content before they know whom they need to reach, what makes them valuable, or which messages will resonate.
learn: Clarify what makes the business valuable
Identify the messages that earn attention and credibility
Connect expertise and customer outcomes to the questions buyers already ask
leave: A practical go-to-market direction that guides what to create, where to share it and how to lead interested people toward the business.
leave2: A stronger foundation before time and money go into production.

title: Build a Year of Content From One Production Day
full: Build a Year of Content From One Production Day
headline: A year of content starts weeks before the cameras turn on.
summary: Plan a focused shoot, capture credible customer stories and turn the footage into a year of marketing content.
short: Plan the shoot, capture the stories
block: Business owners, founders and marketing teams who want to build credibility, show customer results and keep a steady supply of marketing content without frequent video shoots.
learn: Select and invite the right participants
Prepare interview questions that draw out real stories
Write an effective introduction and outro
Find the strongest moments and organize footage around key messages
Turn interviews into short-form videos and other marketing assets
leave: A repeatable system that captures authentic social proof and turns one production day into a year of useful marketing content.
leave2: Pairs with the live workshop on February 4.

title: Reach the Right Audience at the Right Time
full: Reach the Right Audience at the Right Time
headline: Great content only works when the right people see it.
summary: Match content to buyer questions, channels and timing. Publish with purpose, not at random.
block: Businesses create useful content but publish without a deliberate distribution strategy connected to customer questions and buying decisions.
learn: Select channels and set the timing for each piece
Connect topics to the questions buyers ask on the path to a decision
leave: A consistent approach that keeps the business visible, builds credibility and moves interested people to the next step.
leave2: Put the content library to work with purpose, not at random.
blockHighlight: connected to customer questions and buying decisions.
